name: Requiem: Possessed Grin
description: Possessed mobs get demonic powers: levitation, telekinesis, telepathy, a 180-degree head turn, green bile, poltergeist fury, an icy presence, a demon's voice, unholy strength and a spider-walk. Possess the Warden, Wither and Ender Dragon with their real attacks. Every possessed mob gets glowing white eyes and a malicious grin, and even passive mobs can fight.
